subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should maintainers require a rebased repair with live or sanctioned Feishu/CardKit proof before this PR can merge, or accept a proof override after maintainer verification?
rationale: The contributor cannot provide a live Feishu tenant capture, while ClawSweeper cannot mark helper console output and mocked dispatcher tests as sufficient real behavior proof for an external Feishu-visible change.

options.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
options.body: Tighten the helper, resolve the current main conflict, and require redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

options.title: Override Proof After Maintainer Verification
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the proof gap if they verify the Feishu path through a sanctioned tenant or accept the channel-specific risk.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Streaming Work
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers want the latest-token case handled together with the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability tracker.

recommendation.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
recommendation.body: Tighten the helper, resolve the current main conflict, and require redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live PR assignee and have recent Feishu area history, making them the best available owner for the proof override and branch-disposition choice.
